verdict.rationale: Outlook's mail can be driven headlessly through its documented REST API. Apps can draft, send, read, sync and set up rules over HTTP from any language, which supports scripted automation without the UI. However, nothing in the evidence documents running in a CI pipeline, an official CLI, unattended app-only authentication, or hands-on reports of headless/CI use. missing for 10: CI-specific guidance or examples, an official CLI or headless runner, documented non-interactive/service authentication, independent corroboration of headless automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: you can implement this in any language or platform capable of sending HTTP requests.
Draft, read, reply, forward, send, update, or delete messages
Send the message specified in the request body using either JSON or MIME format.
Synchronize messages or mail folder hierarchy
Use Inbox rules to automate actions such as forwarding specific incoming messages
